messages:
Erin: Trying to decide plans for Saturday — lazy farmer's market + waffle truck in the morning, or an escape room with a bunch of friends in the evening? Both sound tempting. Any takers? :thinking_face:
Leo: Waffles forever. But I'd do escape room if we can make a team name. :waffle: :lock:
Sam: I am 100% in for an escape room. I need to prove to myself I can find one key without panicking. :sweat_smile:
Nina: Market + waffles for me. Also I'm on a low-key mission to buy a new houseplant. :seedling:
Erin: Poll time, reply M for market or E for escape. I'll tally in an hour and set a plan.
Leo: M
Sam: E
Nina: M
Erin: Looks like market wins 3-1. Plan: meet at the east entrance of the market at 9:30am. Waffle truck is usually by the fountain. I'll add a quick note in calendar.
calendar-bot: Event created by Erin: "Saturday Market + Waffles" — Saturday 09:30 — Attendees: Erin, Leo, Nina. (Sam pending)
Sam: Darn, will be late to market but may join for brunch if you're still around. Have fun plant hunting!
Nina: If Sam shows, we'll order an extra waffle and save a bite. Also if anyone spots a Monstera adansonii, scream in this thread.
Leo: Promise dramatic scream if spotted. Also, if anyone wants to carpool from the office at 9am, ping me.
Erin: Carpool from office at 9am -> added. If anything changes I'll update here. Market squad hype! :sparkles:
